assertions.assertion: CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-22
Reason Code CO-22 indicates that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient's presentation raises concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias
The concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias is documented in the clinical indication note
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with rhythm disturbances and guide further management
The Holter monitor ordering is consistent with the supporting diagnosis codes R55, I48.91, and I49.9
